about: #206 docs §8.103 7 (3): the hand examples of stage 2 and their answers, written before the programs that check them (research/ownerhold.ts MODE=costhand, research/ownerhold-check.py --cost-hand). The slots avoided are the provisional ones (every pair, summer 21:00-21:59 UTC = slots 84-87, winter 22:00-22:59 = slots 88-91). P: T + 2 minutes, or with sent (as (b)) the sent minute rounded up + 1 minute; then moved past Rakuten's stop (summer 20:55-21:10 UTC, winter 21:55-22:10). E is the open of the order's side in P's bar (taken at the market there), TP E ± tpPips (10 unless given). R is 2026-10-08.
